entities.summary: Ali Bader is an Iraqi-Belgian novelist and script writer. He is the author of 18 novels and the editor-in-chief of Arabic publishing house Alca Books. His best-known works include Papa Sartre, The Tobacco Keeper, The Running after the Wolves, and The Sinful Woman. He lives in Brussels.
